title: Christianity vs Islam
content: Christianity teaches that Jesus is the Son of God who was crucified and resurrected for the salvation of humanity. Islam teaches that Jesus was a prophet and denies His crucifixion and divinity. The core difference centers on the identity of Jesus and the means of salvation.

title: Christianity vs Hinduism
content: Christianity teaches one personal God and salvation by grace through faith. Hinduism includes a wide range of beliefs, often involving multiple deities and the cycle of rebirth governed by karma. Christianity teaches resurrection and eternal life rather than reincarnation.

title: Christianity vs Buddhism
content: Buddhism generally does not focus on a personal Creator God and seeks enlightenment through personal effort and detachment from desire. Christianity teaches relationship with a personal God and salvation through Christ rather than self-enlightenment.

title: Is Christianity Exclusive?
content: Christianity teaches that salvation is found uniquely in Jesus Christ. This exclusivity is based on the belief that Christ alone atoned for sin and conquered death through His resurrection.
